name: Ring of the Anchor, Greater
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

As a ring of the anchor, but it instead adds 100 pounds to the character’s carried weight and imparts a -10 penalty to his Swim checks. The extra weight remains in effect for 2d6 minutes after the ring is no longer covered with water.

This ring can only be removed either by the casting of remove curse or keeping the ring covered in holy water for 24 hours. Either method destroys the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of swimming, improved

Identification DC 32
False Identification DC 22
